remarks: Welcome to the Kingswood a luxury 55+ Community. This sunny and spacious 1 bedroom with den, has two full baths, an open concept kitchen with breakfast bar, ample living room and dining room, walk in pantry and large closets. The den has builtins and can comfortably accommodate guests and makes a terrific office as well. Common charges include all utilities, reserved outdoor parking space and storage unit in lower level. Fully equipped fitness room and stunning community room with fireplace, pool table, library, full kitchen makes entertaining or catering parties a breeze. Backyard covered patio, grilling area and beautiful grounds are perfect spot for enjoying the outdoors. All perfectly and conveniently located to I 95, transportation, shopping, dog park and cove island beach. Pet friendly, lovely community to live and enjoy.
